accrueInterest().details: Permissionless and idempotent within a block. Every state-changing entry point      calls it first, so all reads downstream are already up to date.

availableLiquidity().details: Derived from the accounting rather than from `ASSET.balanceOf(address(this))`.      Reading the raw balance would let anyone inflate the pool's apparent liquidity with      a direct token transfer, and would count borrowers' collateral as lendable.

borrow(uint256).details: Required by the assignment: enforces the 80% utilisation cap and accrues interest      first.      Order of operations, and why it is this order:        1. `accrueInterest()` first. Every check below reads `totalBorrowed`, `debtOf`           and `utilization()`. If interest were accrued afterwards, all three would be           stale and a borrower could squeeze under a cap they are actually already past.           This is the assignment's explicit requirement and it is also the only correct           order.        2. Liquidity check, so the pool cannot promise cash it does not hold — and           specifically cannot lend out collateral that is earmarked for liquidations.        3. Record the debt.        4. Check the caps on the RESULTING state, not the state before. Checking           beforehand would let a single large borrow jump straight past both limits.        5. Transfer last (checks-effects-interactions), so a callback-bearing token           cannot re-enter and borrow twice against one collateral position.

params.amount: Amount of underlying to post as collateral.

returns._0: True when the position is at or above `LIQUIDATION_LTV`.

liquidate(address,uint256).details: Required by the assignment: opens at 90% LTV and accrues interest first.      `accrueInterest()` must run before the health check for the same reason as in      `borrow`, but the risk points the other way: without it, `debtOf(user)` is stale      and *understates* the debt, so genuinely insolvent positions would look healthy and      could not be liquidated. Bad debt would then accumulate silently until the pool      could not honour withdrawals.      The liquidator repays at most `CLOSE_FACTOR` of the debt and receives the repaid      value plus `LIQUIDATION_BONUS` in collateral. The seizure is capped at the      borrower's actual collateral, so a position that is more than ~105% LTV is simply      liquidated for everything it has and the shortfall stays as bad debt — the      alternative would be to revert, which would leave the position untouchable.

params.repayAmount: Amount of the borrower's debt to repay.

returns._0: LTV ratio; `type(uint256).max` when there is debt but no collateral.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

repay(address,uint256).details: Anyone may repay on anyone's behalf. This is safe — it only ever reduces someone's      liability — and it lets a borrower be rescued by a third party before liquidation.

params.amount: Amount of underlying to repay. Capped at the outstanding debt.

setRateParameters(uint256,uint256).details: Bounded so the owner cannot set a rate that would liquidate the whole book in one      block. `onlyOwner` because an open setter would let anyone do exactly that.

params.newBaseRate: New rate at 0% utilisation, per year, WAD-scaled.
params.newSlope: New additional rate at 100% utilisation, per year, WAD-scaled.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

withdrawCollateral(uint256).details: Accrues first, then checks the LTV that the withdrawal would leave behind.      Skipping the accrual here would let a borrower pull collateral out against a stale,      understated debt figure and leave the pool with an instantly-insolvent position.

ASSET().notice: The asset that is lent, borrowed and posted as collateral.

CLOSE_FACTOR().notice: Fraction of a borrower's debt a single liquidation may repay (50%).

LIQUIDATION_BONUS().notice: Discount the liquidator receives on seized collateral (5%).

LIQUIDATION_LTV().notice: LTV at or above which a position may be liquidated (90%).

MAX_UTILIZATION().notice: Highest utilisation a borrow may leave the pool at (80%).

SECONDS_PER_YEAR().notice: Seconds in the interest year the annual rates are quoted against.

accrueInterest().notice: Accrues interest up to the current block timestamp.

availableLiquidity().notice: Cash the pool can lend or pay out right now.

baseRate().notice: Interest rate at 0% utilisation, per year, WAD-scaled (2% by default).

borrow(uint256).notice: Borrows `amount` of the underlying against the caller's posted collateral.

borrowIndex().notice: Cumulative borrow index. Starts at WAD and only ever increases.

currentBorrowRate().notice: Current annual borrow rate at the pool's utilisation, WAD-scaled.

debtOf(address).notice: Debt of `account`, including all interest accrued up to the last accrual.

deposit(uint256).notice: Supplies `amount` of the underlying to be lent out.

depositCollateral(uint256).notice: Posts `amount` of collateral for the caller.

depositOf(address).notice: Lender balance of `account`, including all interest earned.

lastAccrualTime().notice: Timestamp of the most recent accrual.

liquidate(address,uint256).notice: Repays part of an unhealthy borrower's debt and seizes their collateral at a         discount.

slope().notice: Extra interest rate added at 100% utilisation, per year, WAD-scaled (8%).

supplyIndex().notice: Cumulative supply index. Starts at WAD and only ever increases.

totalBorrowed().notice: Total owed by all borrowers, including accrued interest.

totalCollateral().notice: Total collateral posted across all borrowers.

totalDeposited().notice: Total owed to all lenders, including accrued interest.

totalScaledDebt().notice: Sum of every borrower's scaled debt.

totalScaledDeposit().notice: Sum of every lender's scaled balance.

utilization().notice: Current utilisation of the pool, WAD-scaled (1e18 == 100%).

withdraw(uint256).notice: Withdraws `amount` of supplied liquidity plus accrued interest.
